mainEntity.name: What building codes and zoning regulations apply to multigenerational tiny homes in Oceanside?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Oceanside, multigenerational tiny homes are typically treated as Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs). Regulations govern factors like maximum size, setbacks from property lines, parking requirements, and utility connections. The City of Oceanside has specific ordinances that may allow for attached or detached ADUs, with varying size limits based on the primary residence's footprint. We will assist in navigating these local codes to ensure your multigenerational tiny home meets all compliance standards for your specific property.
